newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to send 24-member rescue team to Cairo.
newsitem.headline: Japan to send 24-member rescue team to Cairo.

text.p: Japan will send a 24-member rescue team to help efforts to save about 100 people trapped in a collapsed apartment block in Cairo, a Japanese Foreign Ministry spokesman said on Tuesday.

The team, comprising rescue specialists from the Japanese police and fire departments as well as the coast guard, plus officials from the Foreign Ministry, would depart on Wednesday and arrive in Cairo on Thursday, spokesman Hiroshi Hashimoto told a news conference.
Egyptian rescue workers said on Monday that they had recovered 10 bodies and feared more than 100 people were trapped in the rubble of an 11-storey apartment block which collapsed on Sunday evening.
The Japanese team would be equipped with remote-controlled electromagnetic stethoscopes, fiber optic scopes and specialised audio equipment to locate survivors in the rubble, Hashimoto said.
Hashimoto said France and Switzerland had offered to send similar teams.
